location.title: Library location
location.guidance: Changing the location doesn't move existing songs.
location.defaultUnavailable: The default folder can't be created. Choose another location.
location.customUnavailable: Your setting is kept. Reconnect the drive or choose another location.

history.title: Play history
history.guidance: Saved automatically; clearing it doesn't affect the queue or playlists.
history.clearMessage: Recent play history will be cleared, and artists and albums in the sidebar return to their default order.
history.clearDetail: The play queue, playlists, OBS sessions and error log are kept.
history.updateFailed: Recent play history can't be updated right now.
history.readFailed: Recent play history can't be read right now.
history.clearedMessage: The play queue and playlists are kept.

storage.title: Library storage
storage.cleanupHint: Over the limit or when the drive is low on space, vocal-removed versions are cleaned up; original songs are kept. Turning this on checks right away.
storage.cleanupMessage: Vocal-removed versions that can be recreated are cleaned up based on the limit and free drive space.
storage.cleanupDetail: Original songs are kept, and vocal-removed versions can be recreated when needed.
storage.readFailed: Library storage can't be read right now.
storage.saveFailed: The storage setting can't be saved right now; the previous setting is kept.

metadata.title: Library information
metadata.guidance: Local data is tidied at startup; albums and track order are filled in online, keeping your manual edits.
metadata.fillHint: Connect to fill in albums and full track order, keeping your manual edits.
metadata.locationChanged: The library location changed. Update again.
metadata.enableSourcesNotice: Turn on external sources to fill in releases and full track order.
metadata.filled: {count} release filled in. | {count} releases filled in.
metadata.stopped: Stopped; {count} release filled in. | Stopped; {count} releases filled in.
metadata.interrupted: Update interrupted; {count} release filled in. Check the library and external source settings, then retry. | Update interrupted; {count} releases filled in. Check the library and external source settings, then retry.
metadata.nothingToFill: Nothing can be filled in from sources right now.
metadata.unresolved: {count} source is still incomplete; you can retry later. | {count} sources are still incomplete; you can retry later.
metadata.needsConfirmation: {count} more song needs confirming with "Fill in album details" in its track menu. | {count} more songs need confirming with "Fill in album details" in their track menus.
metadata.refreshFailed: Release information can't be updated right now. Try again later.
metadata.stopFailed: Can't stop right now. Try again later.
metadata.reloadFailed: The library can't be reloaded right now. Try again later.
